Subject: Post-call: ACME Health Tech — technical deep-dive (60–90 min)

Hi Lena / Aaron —

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to learn more about ACME’s roadmap for clinical note summarization. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Goal: generate structured clinical summaries and problem lists from raw visit notes to populate downstream workflows.
- Volume estimate: ~15M notes/year today; expected to grow to ~30M in 12 months.
- Performance targets: P50 latency <400ms for short summaries, throughput ~100 req/s sustained, burst to 500 req/s during peak.
- Data sensitivity: PHI in scope; must keep data residency in US; SOC 2 + additional audit logs preferred.

As discussed, the right next step is a technical deep dive (60–90 minutes) with your ML and infra/security teams so we can:
1) walk through architecture and data flows (how notes will be ingested and retained),
2) align on SLAs/perf targets and load testing plan,
3) review security controls (KMS, audit logs, private deployment options),
4) discuss deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and cost/latency tradeoffs, and
5) agree next steps and a mutual action plan.

Suggested slots (PT):
- Wed, Sep 16 — 10:00–11:30 PT
- Thu, Sep 17 — 09:00–10:30 PT
- Thu, Sep 17 — 14:00–15:30 PT

Who from ACME would you like on the call? Based on your notes, it sounds like we should include the ML lead + platform/infra and someone from security/compliance. From our side I’ll bring Camila (solutions engineer) and Ethan (SE) and we can include Vivek (infra) if you want to dig into deployment topology.

I’ve attached a short brief and a draft agenda for the session. Calendly link / invite below — if one of the slots works, I’ll send a calendar invite with an agenda and a shared drive link for pre-reads.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/60min
